title: ELIMFILTERS Axial Seal Air Filters — Product Identity & Printing Standard

ink.name: ELIMFILTERS Neutral Grey
ink.note: Pantone is a production communication reference; final acceptance is against the approved physical Golden Sample and released supplier ink specification.

requiredPrintedElements: ELIMFILTERS master identity in curved half-moon orientation
PRIMARY AIR FILTER or SECONDARY AIR FILTER
manufacturingControls: Use only controlled ELIMFILTERS and MACROCORE assets from frontend/public/assets/.
Do not redraw, retype, stretch, approximate or substitute official logos.
Do not use yellow paint, yellow ink or yellow decorative graphics on the filter product.
The curved half-moon effect belongs to the ELIMFILTERS logo placement itself, not to a colored graphic behind or above the logo.
Keep all printing off the filter media.
Do not print on the axial sealing/gasket surface.
Keep artwork clear of the airflow opening and sealing geometry.
Primary and secondary filters must be explicitly identified in the printed Product Type.
Mass production requires approval of a physical Golden Sample.
